entities.name: Aquaporin-like protein 2
observations: The 149-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed Saccharomyces cerevisiae aquaporin-like protein 2 sequences C7GNE3, A7A0K8, and P0CD90 at 100% identity and full-length coverage.
Predicted molecular weight is 17,024 Da; theoretical pI is 4.86; estimated charge at pH 7 is -9.94.
Annotated as a multi-pass membrane water channel.
Localizes to the endoplasmic reticulum membrane and plasma membrane.

Catalyzes or facilitates water transport across membranes; associated GO terms include water channel activity (GO:000562? exact activity term reported as GO:0015250), transmembrane transport (GO:0055085), and water transport (GO:0006833).
In Saccharomyces cerevisiae, associated biological roles include freeze tolerance, osmotolerance, and cell flocculation in liquid cultures.
The protein is reported as non-functional in most laboratory yeast strains; this is strain/context-dependent and should not be generalized to all alleles.
No Pfam domain result was available; this is an analysis limitation, not evidence that domains are absent.

entities.name: C7GNE3
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference from Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain JAY291; exact sequence match to the query.
Annotated as aquaporin-like protein 2 and a water channel in the ER membrane and cell membrane.

entities.name: A7A0K8
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference from Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain YJM789; exact sequence match to the query.
Annotated as aquaporin-like protein 2 and a water channel in the ER membrane and cell membrane.

entities.name: P0CD90
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference from Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain S288c; exact sequence match to the query.
GO annotations include water channel activity, transmembrane transport, and water transport.
Annotated roles include freeze tolerance, osmotolerance, and cell flocculation.
